review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The exact finite result characterizes optimal designs through a very large orbit-game feasibility system rather than an analytic description of the optimizers, limiting its direct practical use. The strict noncanonical advantage is proved only for J=2, s=1 and only against the paper-defined paired–Bernoulli segment, so it does not establish a general superiority pattern. The asymptotic results determine the sharp first-order risk, low-discordance concentration, and the face of o(J^{-1})-optimal procedures, but they do not characterize limits of exact minimizers when rho is at least 1/2. The advertised J^{-4/3} residual functional, Gamma limit, and exact-selection contact set remain open, as the framing acknowledges, and therefore contribute no established second-order frontier. The unrestricted-endpoint reduction also relies on a recent imported minimax lemma without an exact theorem locator or proof, so that endpoint claim requires source verification. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7.2 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: fisher-information-miscalculated@thm:phase-transition, fisher-information-miscalculated@thm:first-order-face
